meta.title: Free game launcher for Windows | Izacki
meta.description: The Izacki Launcher installs, runs and updates FERRA, Tower Défense Infini and VIGIE. Free, for Windows 10 and 11, with a free Izacki account.

hero.title: The Launcher to install and run Izacki games.
hero.lead: One app to find a game, install it, run it and keep it up to date. It is free and it updates itself.
hero.plateAlt: The Store of the Izacki Launcher: the FERRA showcase, the two Izacki games below it, and the filters Tout, Jeux Izacki, Communauté and Gratuits.

dl.label: Download
dl.title: What you need.
dl.accountValue: A free Izacki account. Your email address has to be confirmed when you sign up.

smartscreen.title: Windows may show a warning the first time.
smartscreen.text: The app is not yet signed by a certified publisher. The steps to carry on are in the FAQ:

spaces.label: In the Launcher
spaces.title: What the Launcher contains.

store.title: Store (Boutique)
store.text: Search and four filters: Tout (all), Jeux Izacki, Communauté (community) and Gratuits (free). Izacki's games are free. Community games have a price in credits, sometimes zero.

library.title: Library (Bibliothèque)
library.text: Your installed games, with search and sorting. Each game has four tabs: Aperçu (overview), Succès (achievements), Nouveautés (what's new) and Informations. Updates and installs are in Téléchargements (downloads).

community.title: Community (Communauté)
community.text: Friends and groups with group chat, a leaderboard, and a link to the Discord. To add a friend, you use their tag, in the form Username#Number.

creators.title: Creators (Créateurs)
creators.text: Publish a game and follow its sales and withdrawals. The team reviews every game before it is published.

support.title: Support (Assistance)
support.text: A question, a bug, a refund? You open a ticket, attach a screenshot if needed, and the answer comes in the ticket.

spaces.note: The Launcher is in French: the names in brackets are the ones you will see in the app.

games.label: Games
games.title: Three games to install.
games.ferraText: A world to rebuild, a fire to protect, a meteorite to face. Mine, automate, defend your camp, and get ready for the night.
games.tdText: A tower defense against endless waves of zombies: you place towers along the road and see how long you can hold.
games.vigieText: A lighthouse lost in the middle of the sea, a lamp, creatures rising from the waves: aim the beam and hold out until dawn.

security.label: Security
security.title: Up to date, checked, adjustable.
security.p1: The Launcher updates itself: it checks at startup, downloads the update, then restarts. Updates are signed.
security.p2: Before launching an official game, it runs an integrity check: it compares the executable with the published fingerprint, and reinstalls it if it was modified or damaged.
security.p3: An official game that is not up to date does not start: the Launcher sends you to Téléchargements (downloads).
security.p4: Automatic game updates are a setting, off by default, that applies to each device separately.
security.plateAlt: The Appearance setting in the Launcher settings: five accent colors to choose from, Cuivre, Azur, Émeraude, Violet and Cramoisi, with a preview.

creators.label: Creators
creators.title: Publish a game on Izacki.
creators.lead: In the Créateurs (Creators) space of the Launcher, the “Sortir mon jeu” screen asks for your game file, a name, a price and some visuals. The team reviews every game before publication.
creators.fileValue: A .zip archive containing index.html, or a Windows .exe
creators.priceValue: In credits; zero for a free game
creators.visualsValue: An optional banner and 3 to 5 screenshots
creators.reviewValue: The team reviews every game; you receive an email and a notification
creators.withdrawalsText: Withdrawals of real money follow the terms on the Terms & Privacy page.

q1.title: Windows warning at launch
q1.text: Windows may show a warning before opening the installer, because the Launcher is not yet signed by a certified publisher.

q2.title: Antivirus or browser blocking the file
q2.text: If your antivirus or your browser holds back the downloaded file, the answer is in the FAQ.

q3.title: Games installation folder
q3.text: You can change the installation folder in Paramètres (settings), then Téléchargements et stockage (downloads and storage). Games that are already installed are moved.
